title: tui: the list as the first screen, the board on a key
body: The board was the wrong first screen. Make bare foam open what foam list shows: open and in-progress issues by priority, nested under a listed parent with the tree leads, the rollup on milestones and 'waits on' after a blocked one, through the same forest builder render.rs uses. The board stays one key away (Tab) since its rows already exist. Filters as in foam list come later with the detail pane.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/6de6737a
notes.text: Done: View::List is the default, View::Board on Tab, both from the same snapshot. list_rows goes through render::forest, now pub(crate) with separate lifetimes for the issues and the row slice, so the tree leads, rollups and 'waits on' match foam list exactly. Every list row is selectable; headers only exist on the board.
